ruleDefinitions.name: Renamed PAExec Execution
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects execution of renamed version of PAExec. Often used by attackers

sequences.query: (process_description = "PAExec\ Application" OR process_original_file_name = "PAExec\.exe" OR process_product = RGX(".*PAExec.*") OR (process_hash = RGX(".*IMPHASH\\=11D40A7B7876288F919AB819CC2D9802.*") OR process_hash = RGX(".*IMPHASH\\=6444f8a34e99b8f7d9647de66aabe516.*") OR process_hash = RGX(".*IMPHASH\\=dfd6aa3f7b2b1035b76b718f1ddc689f.*") OR process_hash = RGX(".*IMPHASH\\=1a6cca4d5460b1710a12dea39e4a592c.*"))) AND  NOT ((process_path = RGX("\\\\paexec\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\PAExec\\-")))
